title: Presumptive Eligibility Under the Patient Financial Assistance Program: Qualifying Enrollments and Proof of Enrollment
content:
Under the Patient Financial Assistance Program, an applicant may qualify without an income assessment by showing enrollment in a qualifying program. The tier that rests on enrollment is the Presumptive Eligibility Full Discount; the five other tiers list no qualifying enrollment.

## Terms by tier

| Tier | Enrollments that qualify without an income assessment | Current proof of enrollment required | Proof of enrollment is current if dated no more than this many calendar days before the application date | Document that proves documented homelessness |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Financial Assistance 25% Discount | None | No | 0 (not applicable) | Not applicable |
| Financial Assistance 50% Discount | None | No | 0 (not applicable) | Not applicable |
| Financial Assistance 75% Discount | None | No | 0 (not applicable) | Not applicable |
| Financial Assistance Full Discount | None | No | 0 (not applicable) | Not applicable |
| Presumptive Eligibility Full Discount | Medicaid enrollment; SNAP enrollment; WIC enrollment; documented homelessness | Yes | 90 | A shelter or caseworker letter |
| Catastrophic Medical Hardship Adjustment | None | No | 0 (not applicable) | Not applicable |

## Terms explained

1. **Qualifying enrollments.** For the Presumptive Eligibility Full Discount, the applicant qualifies on any one of four enrollments: Medicaid, SNAP, WIC, or documented homelessness.
2. **Proof must be current.** A proof-of-enrollment document is required for this tier, and it is current only when it is dated no more than 90 calendar days before the application date. A proof dated longer ago than 90 days before the application date is not current.
3. **Homelessness.** Documented homelessness is proved by a letter from a shelter or from a caseworker.

## Examples (hypothetical dates)

- Application received on 1 June; proof of SNAP enrollment dated 3 March of the same year, 90 days earlier: current.
- Application received on 1 June; proof of WIC enrollment dated 2 March of the same year, 91 days earlier: not current.
